notes: Advanced Token & Context Management. Universal usage tracking across all agents: Sidekick reports metered ACTUAL usage, Claude Code reports its structured result-event usage (input/output/cached tokens, cost, model, duration), and DeepSeek Harness + Antigravity are recorded as NOT_TRACKED session metadata because their CLIs do not expose token usage. New Context Manager with reference context windows (override -> learned -> reference -> UNKNOWN) and automatic context-limit learning from explicit provider overflow errors. Advanced context compaction with measured savings and a preview summary. Per-agent and per-project budgets (plus per-provider/per-model), reliability filter (ACTUAL/ESTIMATED/NOT_TRACKED), per-project/per-session breakdowns, and a Context tab with manual overrides. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2).
